God of War is an absolute masterpiece.
This story has genuinely got to be one of the best stories that I have ever played, the combat feels truly amazing and it just overall is great.
I mean, Hel, there's a reason that this game won Game of the Year in 2018 and it shows in the whole game, especially the cinematic cutscenes. What is also beautiful about this game are both the designs of the environment and of Kratos, Atreus and every other character that appears in this game. And, the soundtrack made every situation feel just that much better and it really helped me enjoy the game just that much more.

Awesome game. Perfect combination of visuals, engaging combat, amazing voice acting and story.
Can't go wrong with this one.
Only gripe I have is that the late game activities are a bit boring and repetitive (the challenge realms). They seem more an afterthought to grind for NG+ than anything else.

There can always be a new sentence after a full stop, that's what God of War 2018 is. The first modern installment of the great franchise. The game really honoured the previous titles, it's like the classic GoW but upgraded. The peeps who played the classics can relate. The game is visually great as we move from Greek mythology to Norse and this time we got company as in friendly. The pacing is so good, not to mention the beautiful soundtracks, gameplay is fun and so is the combat. The cinematics are another great department they did absolutely well, especially the combat shots. Acting was great and overall amazing. There's so much to explore, good amount of side activities which is very rewarding at times.

Breathtaking graphics, great story telling, fun combat, harmonious, sweet-sounding music, immersing world and well thought out characters with depth, those are what most people defines a masterpiece, and GoW 2018 contains exactly all those qualities. Sure there are some flaws with it, such as bosses that are too easy and could be beaten with button smashing. The puzzles that takes some time to complete and destroys the pace of the game. Those may sound as bad flaws but the good qualities BY FAR outweighs the bad ones. Is the game worth the 50$ price tag? Definitely. It is worth every. single. penny. of. it. A masterpiece, is what i categorize this as. Of course that is only my opinion.

TL;DR: Overall a great game, puzzles are a little meh tho. 9/10

I couldn’t help but think of how Santa Monica took the best of GoW as a franchise and melded it beautifully with the most distinguishable designs of other modern games to create something with an immensely potent synergy. In a single word, holistic. Every aspect is excellent on its own, but more importantly, it all serves and accentuates the larger vision. Some die-hard fans may fear this isn’t really God of War. I suppose they’re right. It’s even better. The game feels more mature, profound and solid than we have ever seen in the saga. And now, the best part, we can enjoy it in the best way possible, on PC. Brilliant story and game. 5/5

A game almost never EXCEEDS my expectations but this one did. Probably the best game story since Half Life 2, combat was excellent and challenging (I was on PC so struggled with all the various different types of attacks on some of the harder fights). Voice acting and dialogue were excellent as well. Easier than a normal Souls game but still very challenging (especially some of the trickier bosses). Alot of good puzzles and exploration as well. Felt like a mix of Dark Souls and Tomb Raider (the renamke). I give it 9.5/10.
Even in 2026 this game has one of the best stories and glorious graphics out there. Highly recommended. Combat is great, characters are amazing, great story telling by the developers.

God of War is the best Playstation title I have played to date. It does everything so damn well and we are truly blessed to have this masterpiece on PC. If you are even thinking about buying it and you enjoy single player games JUST DO IT.

The graphics and visuals in this game are unmatched as each and every new region is unique and ripe for exploration.

The story follows your journey seamlessly and nothing you do ever feels pointless or uneventful. The characters and individuals with their own backstories and personality types. The enemies feel like actual villains in the way of accomplishing your goals.

The gameplay systems are decent and allow for extensive customization if you want, but does not force anything.

The combat is always different with new enemy types and weapons being introduced along your journey with their own unique move sets and challenges.

TLDR - God of War is one of the few open world games that gets it right and makes you want to go out and complete everything it has to offer. I cannot recommend it enough.

Great game with some very exciting moments, great tactile and impactful gameplay, that just feels very organic. Many combos and moves to learn, great armor pieces and some hard bosses. Mimir is definitely a great exposition machine talking about the backstories of many characters and why what happened. The characters are very well fleshed out. I quite like the mature and calmer Kratos, it is definitel different from the angry and quite frankly - inhumane Kratos of the past.

One of the best RPGs of recent years, God of War offers an immersive and fantastic open world while continuing Kratos' story as he tries to escape his past and raise his son. The souls-like gameplay fits the Norse world perfectly and helps focus the fact that the duo are way out of their league. Whether you like such games or not, it's a game that you must have. The story touches on the heartstrings of all ages and the stellar graphics and sound design only help shine more light on it.

Imagine this: A top company releasing a most anticipated PC game with ONLY DX11 in 2022.
Now, picture the following: Automatically capping everyone using an AMD GPU, since we all know those run far better on DX12.
Not enough? Don't worry, there's more. Imagine nVidia users only able to play enough until memory leaking kicks in and crashes their game.

What company would even consider releasing a game with: no Fullscreen option, no Field of View slider, no Anti-Aliasing option, no Ambient Occlusion setting, and permanent negative mouse acceleration, and despite all these lacking, would still make the industry praise it? Oh, of course it's SONY.

How much do we have to SIMP to get Bloodborne again? Well, considering this absolute trash port, maybe we really don't need it. Imagine fighting bosses in DX11 at 20 frames per second, when your 1 thousand dollar GPU sits there chilling at 57% usage.

If this is SONY's way of convincing us to buy their latest toaster, it's no use.

2022, the more things change...
The more they stay the same!

God of War is an absolute masterpiece that took me on an incredible adventure for 36 hours straight. From the stunning visuals to the engaging gameplay, this game has it all.

The graphics are breathtaking, and every detail in the game world is meticulously crafted. The combat mechanics are spot-on, making each encounter feel impactful and satisfying. Upgrading Kratos' abilities adds a sense of progression and personalization.

The story is where God of War truly shines. It delves into the complex relationship between Kratos and his son, exploring powerful themes of parenthood and redemption. The writing is exceptional, and the voice acting brings the characters to life, making their journey relatable and emotionally charged.

Exploring the vast world of God of War is a delight. There are side quests, hidden treasures, and puzzles to discover, keeping you engaged and rewarded. The boss battles are epic, creating memorable moments that will leave you in awe.

The music, composed by Bear McCreary, sets the perfect tone for the Norse mythology-inspired adventure. It elevates the game to new heights, adding an epic and immersive atmosphere.

God of War is a true gem that will leave a lasting impression. It combines action, storytelling, and mythology flawlessly, creating an unforgettable gaming experience. If you're looking for an incredible journey, don't miss out on God of War. Get ready to be captivated from start to finish!

This game is a masterpiece. From story to the graphics it keeps you hooked!
The only thing I could complain about is the grindy parts( getting the collectibles after the main story.) At the time of this review I have spent 50 hours playing through the story and grinding, and I still haven't finished. As an impatient achievement hoarder this was way to much for me. You have to explore large maps while being focused( since some collectibles in the game are hard to see, require solving puzzles or having to fight an intense bossfight.) This all makes it hard to relax and enjoy the actual experience that was intended...
Again this game is great! Atleast if you don't intend to 100% complete it. 9/10 BUY IT!!

Title: God of War: Epic Action and Emotional Journey

Rating: ★★★★★ (5/5)

God of War is a remarkable action-adventure game that combines intense combat, breathtaking visuals, and a deeply emotional narrative. Kratos' journey through Norse mythology delivers an unforgettable gaming experience. With its compelling story, satisfying gameplay mechanics, and stunning visuals, God of War stands as a true masterpiece in the world of gaming.
Really enjoyed this game. The story is great, graphics look amazing, and the views are beautiful. Had a lot of fun playing it. Definitely worth playing

The game feels very different from the PS2-era God of War, but it's still a spectacular game. The dynamic between Kratos and the boy is surprisingly well done. Combat is engaging and never devolves into mindless button mashing. The environmental puzzles in the game are creative and satisfying to figure out.
I definitely recommend playing this game.
